statements.quote: Vertiv delivered strong second quarter performance with net sales of $2,638 million, representing a 35% increase ($685 million) from the prior year period, driven by robust data center demand and continued market penetration.
statements.notes: Total net sales for Q2 2025 only, not the full fiscal year; data center demand named as a driver. The data-center portion is not stated.

statements.quote: We are strategically investing in capacity expansion and accelerating our innovation pipeline to capitalize on unprecedented data center growth, particularly in AI- enabled infrastructure.
statements.notes: Capacity expansion implies capex, but 'investing' is not explicitly capital expenditures. The sentence also covers innovation (ER&D). The full-year capex outlook of $250-$300 million (p04) is tied only to 'strong industry demand', not to AI, so it is not recorded.

statements.quote: To capitalize on these expanding opportunities, we are continuing to accelerate our growth investments, with significant ER&D investments in next- generation technologies and AI-optimized infrastructure solutions.
statements.notes: ER&D investment is linked to AI-optimized solutions in words only. The sentence is present tense, so it is recorded as an actual.
